Featured Match

Top of the table and the team it has not played

Home
willmoran
4–2 · 542 pts
vs
Away
rmeernst
3–3 · 536 pts

willmoran leads the league on points and sits in a four-way share of first. rmeernst is 3-3 and, against the whole field each week, has one of the best records in it. These two were not due to meet until GW12 under the old schedule; the fix brings them together now. The leader has not had a bad week yet, which is rarer than it sounds six games in, and the side across from him has spent the autumn scoring like a contender with nothing in the win column to show for it. Something gives.

Featured Match

The leader who has stopped scoring

Home
brendog2814
4–2 · 538 pts
vs
Away
bjennings28
2–4 · 530 pts

brendog2814 started four from four and still shares the lead, but he has lost two straight and both of them were the lowest scores of his season, back to back. Across from him is bjennings28, who against the whole field has the best record in the league and in the actual table is 2-4, having twice run straight into the week's top score. One of these teams is better than its record and one is worse, and this is the week the table starts to notice.
